member.name: M:Astronomy.XISF.Compression.BlockCompressionInfo.Parse(System.String,System.String)
member.summary:
Parse the raw compression and checksum attribute strings. Either may be null/empty.
compression grammar: codec:uncompressedSize[:itemSize] (itemSize present only for "+sh" variants).
checksum grammar: algorithm:hexDigest. Legacy non-hyphenated algorithm aliases ("sha1"/"sha256"/"sha512") are canonicalized to the spec tokens. An unrecognized codec token parses as (read-side detection must not abort on codecs this library does not decode), but a malformed attribute for a known codec — wrong field count (including sub-block forms, which no supported producer emits), non-numeric or non-positive sizes — is a contract violation and throws.

member.name: T:Astronomy.XISF.Compression.XisfBlockCompression
member.summary: XISF data-block codec: byte-shuffle + zlib / LZ4 / LZ4-HC / Zstandard + checksum, matching the PixInsight/NINA on-disk format. Pure and UI-free. Operates on opaque byte blocks, so it is reusable for any XISF data block by any consumer. and are symmetric — round-tripping any block returns the original bytes.

member.name: M:Astronomy.XISF.Compression.XisfBlockCompression.Shuffle(System.Byte[],System.Int32)
member.summary: Byte-shuffle: regroup an N-byte block of -byte samples so all byte-0s come first, then all byte-1s, … (improves the codec's ratio on multi-byte samples). Reversible via using the same itemSize. A trailing remainder (length not divisible by itemSize) is copied as-is.

member.name: M:Astronomy.XISF.Compression.XisfBlockCompression.Compress(System.Byte[],System.Int32,Astronomy.XISF.Compression.BlockCodec)
member.summary: Compress a raw block: shuffle (when itemSize > 1) → codec → SHA-1 over the compressed bytes. Always returns the compressed result (no no-gain fallback): a block stored uncompressed would read back as uncompressed and be re-attempted on every future save. The recorded codec is the "+sh" variant when shuffled. Levels match the producers this library interoperates with (NINA/PixInsight): zlib SmallestSize, LZ4 fast, LZ4-HC level 6, zstd level 1.
member.param: Bytes per sample; > 1 enables the byte-shuffle.
Base codec family: (default), , , or . The shuffled variant is selected automatically from — passing a "+sh" member here throws.

remarks.para: Constructed by . Keyword names are case-insensitive (matching FITS-spec). Values are normalized at construction: surrounding single quotes (FITS string syntax) stripped; trailing FITS-pad whitespace trimmed.

member.name: T:Astronomy.XISF.XisfHeaderReader
member.summary: Reads FITS-keyword headers from XISF files. Header-only — never touches image data, never mutates the file. Pure managed (System.Xml.Linq), no native deps.

remarks.para: Ported from XisfFileManager's XisfXmlReader.cs read path, stripped of write/mutation logic and XFM-specific UI concerns. Reads only XFM-processed files in practice; pre-XFM files with malformed XML will throw — callers should catch + skip.

The XISF file layout this reader assumes:
Bytes 0–7: ASCII signature "XISF0100".
Bytes 8–11: little-endian unsigned 32-bit XML section byte length.
Bytes 12–15: reserved (skipped).
Bytes 16..16+xmlLen: UTF-8 XML header (the FITS keyword bag lives here).
After that: image attachment blocks (NOT read by this class).
